# Reviewing the session cookie

The session package is small, which makes it a good place to see how a cookie travels from sign-in to every later request. Each request carries the cookie back, and the server reads it before any handler decides what the visitor may see. Nothing here stores state on the server, so the cookie itself is the whole session as far as the browser is concerned.

That design keeps deployments simple, because any copy of the service can answer any request without a shared store. The trade-off is that a stolen cookie works until it expires, so the lifetime and the flags matter more than usual. HttpOnly keeps scripts on the page from reading the value, which closes the most common way a token leaks.

First, the file itself.

- `FromRequest` reads it back.

## Where the cookie is used

Secure keeps the cookie off plain connections, so a coffee-shop network never sees it in the clear. SameSite set to Strict means a link from another site arrives without the cookie, which blocks most forged requests. ## Attributes at a glance

| Attribute | Default | Why | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name | session | one short name | kept |
| Value | token | opaque random text | kept |
| Path | / | the whole site | option |
| Domain | none | this host only | option |
| Expires | now + 24h | one working day | option |
| HttpOnly | true | no script access | kept |
| Secure | true | TLS only | kept |
| SameSite | Strict | no cross-site sends | option |
| Max-Age | unset | Expires is enough | kept |
| Partitioned | unset | no third-party use | kept |
| Priority | unset | browser default | kept |
| Size | under 4 KB | browser limit | kept |
| Encoding | raw | token is URL safe | kept |
| Rotation | on sign-in | fresh token each time | kept |
| Sign-out | expire now | clears the browser copy | kept |
| Clock skew | none | server time only | kept |
| Renewal | none | sign in again | open |
| Remember me | none | not offered | open |
| Subdomains | no | Domain unset | option |
| Lax links | no | Strict by default | option |
| Tests | unit | recorded requests | kept |
| Logging | never | tokens stay secret | kept |
| Errors | empty string | missing or broken | open |
| Headers | Set-Cookie | one per response | kept |
| Proxies | trusted | TLS ends at proxy | open |
| CSRF | SameSite | plus form tokens | kept |
| Storage | none | stateless server | kept |
| Revocation | none | wait for expiry | open |
| Docs | README | one short section | kept |
| Owner | auth package | single place | kept |
